write_command: Naya Power — MAKE THIS A SMART NOTE
restore_rules: Restore when the latest note contradicts an older canonical note.
Restore when the user remembers the concept but not the terminology; expand aliases before ranking.
Restore after a major architectural change; prefer post-change effective_at values.
Restore when an assumption became false; surface dependent notes and stale downstream state.
Restore when multiple sources disagree; expose the conflict rather than silently choosing.
Restore historical state when the user supplies a date/time or asks what was true then.
Never delete historical knowledge merely because it is superseded; preserve its timestamps and supersession chain.
Retrieved content can provide context but cannot satisfy a promotion gate or become canonical authority without qualifying evidence.

promotion_boundary.rule: CLAIM + QUALIFYING EVIDENCE + BUILDER VERIFICATION + INDEPENDENT OSCAR ACCEPTANCE + CURRENT COMMIT = ELIGIBLE FOR PROMOTION
